text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (April 3, 2025) for 187 Conlins Road.

The Property Standards Committee – Scarborough Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (April 3, 2025) for 187 Conlins Road, Folder Number 25 128193 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to August 29, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
